activityParetoAlpha.note: Start value 1.125 (population top 20% share 0.2^(1 - 1/alpha) = 0.836). With 1,000 users the sample has a lighter tail than the law, so the measured skew was 0.674 and the median 9. Calibration round 1 moved it to 0.875.

targets.row: Activity skew (share of votes by the top 20% of voters)

interactionsPerUserMean.note: Total actions = mean x users, so the mean is met by construction.

followeesMean.note: Mean list length of users with a list, capped at users - 1. Start value 24.26. Returned links give a list to almost every user, so the measured mean was 17.5. Calibration round 1 moved it to 34.

targets.row: Followees per user (users with at least 1 followee)

followListShare.note: Near the 51.19% of Digg voters with a list (.docs/datasets.md section 4).

followInSpanShare.note: Share of links dated inside the activity span. The rest are dated before it.

secondaryParetoAlpha.note: Tail of list length, popularity and posting weights.

interestSpread.note: Share of a user's interest that is spread over all topics. The rest sits on the main topic.

maxMembershipsPerUser.note: Other users have 1 to this many memberships.

communityPostShare.note: Share of posts that go to a community of the author.

spanDays.note: Activity span. About 2,000 posts per 7 days at size M.

beforeDays.note: Time before the span, for joins and early links.

lateJoinerShare.note: Users who join inside the span (real cold-start users).

candidateWindowDays.note: W_gen: a user picks a post created in this window.

popularityPi.note: Weight (1 + pi x actions on the post so far). In every world.
